def normalize_email(value: str) -> str:
    """Normalize email for case-insensitive matching."""
    return value.strip().casefold()


def _parse_time(value: str) -> datetime | None:
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        return parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def _known_by(timestamp: str, cutoff: datetime) -> bool:
    parsed = _parse_time(timestamp)
    return parsed is not None and parsed <= cutoff


def _normalize_name(value: str) -> str:
    folded = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", value.casefold())
    without_marks = "".join(char for char in folded if not unicodedata.combining(char))
    return " ".join(without_marks.split())


def resolve_subjects(
    email: str,
    identities: Iterable[Mapping[str, str]],
    audit_log: Iterable[Mapping[str, str]],
    audit_at: str,
    system_activity: Iterable[Mapping[str, str]] = (),
) -> tuple[ResolvedSubject, ...]:
    """Find users matching current or historical identifiers before cutoff.

    The returned identifier set includes historical field values from the audit
    log and current snapshot values only when that snapshot predates the cutoff.
    Identity-link activity can additionally connect those identifiers to
    resource IDs. Other activity event results are not treated as proof of state.
    """
    cutoff = _parse_time(audit_at)
    if cutoff is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid audit_at timestamp: {audit_at}")
    wanted = normalize_email(email)
    identity_rows = tuple(identities)
    audit_rows = tuple(audit_log)
    activity_rows = tuple(system_activity)

    matching_users: set[str] = set()
    for row in identity_rows:
        if _known_by(row.get("updated_at", ""), cutoff) and normalize_email(row.get("email", "")) == wanted:
            matching_users.add(row.get("user_id", ""))

    for row in audit_rows:
        if not _known_by(row.get("event_time", ""), cutoff):
            continue
        if row.get("field_name", "").casefold() != "email":
            continue
        old_value = normalize_email(row.get("old_value", ""))
        new_value = normalize_email(row.get("new_value", ""))
        if wanted in (old_value, new_value) and row.get("user_id"):
            matching_users.add(row["user_id"])

    identifiers_by_user: dict[str, set[str]] = {user_id: {user_id} for user_id in matching_users if user_id}
    names_by_user: dict[str, set[str]] = {user_id: set() for user_id in identifiers_by_user}
    name_owners: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for row in identity_rows:
        user_id = row.get("user_id", "")
        if not user_id or not _known_by(row.get("updated_at", ""), cutoff):
            continue
        name = row.get("name", "").strip()
        if name:
            name_key = _normalize_name(name)
            name_owners.setdefault(name_key, set()).add(user_id)
            if user_id in names_by_user:
                names_by_user[user_id].add(name)
        if user_id not in identifiers_by_user:
            continue
        identifiers_by_user[user_id].update(
            value.strip()
            for field in ("email", "phone", "email_hash")
            if (value := row.get(field, "").strip())
        )

    for row in audit_rows:
        user_id = row.get("user_id", "")
        if not user_id or not _known_by(row.get("event_time", ""), cutoff):
            continue
        if row.get("field_name", "").casefold() == "name":
            for name in (row.get("old_value", ""), row.get("new_value", "")):
                name = name.strip()
                if not name:
                    continue
                name_owners.setdefault(_normalize_name(name), set()).add(user_id)
                if user_id in names_by_user:
                    names_by_user[user_id].add(name)
        if user_id not in identifiers_by_user:
            continue
        identifiers_by_user[user_id].update(
            value.strip()
            for value in (row.get("old_value", ""), row.get("new_value", ""))
            if value.strip() and row.get("field_name", "").casefold() in {"email", "phone", "email_hash"}
        )

    unique_names_by_user = {
        user_id: frozenset(
            name for name in names
            if name_owners.get(_normalize_name(name), set()) == {user_id}
        )
        for user_id, names in names_by_user.items()
    }

    linked_by_user: dict[str, set[str]] = {user_id: set() for user_id in identifiers_by_user}
    resource_pattern = re.compile(
        r"\b(?:account|search|support|support_attachment|analytics|audit_record|tombstone|data_flow|backup|export|"
        r"marketing|cache|telemetry|email_delivery|secondary_identifier|legal_hold)_[0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\b",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    for activity in activity_rows:
        if activity.get("event_type", "").upper() != "LINK_RESOURCE_IDENTITY":
            continue
        if not _known_by(activity.get("event_time", ""), cutoff):
            continue
        details = activity.get("details", "")
        for user_id, values in identifiers_by_user.items():
            matching_values = values | set(unique_names_by_user.get(user_id, ()))
            if not any(_contains_identifier(details, value) for value in matching_values):
                continue
            if activity.get("resource_id"):
                linked_by_user[user_id].add(activity["resource_id"])
            linked_by_user[user_id].update(resource_pattern.findall(details))

    return tuple(
        ResolvedSubject(
            user_id=user_id,
            identifiers=frozenset(values | names_by_user.get(user_id, set())),
            linked_resource_ids=frozenset(linked_by_user.get(user_id, set())),
            weak_identifiers=unique_names_by_user.get(user_id, frozenset()),
            name_identifiers=frozenset(names_by_user.get(user_id, set())),
        )
        for user_id, values in sorted(identifiers_by_user.items())
    )

"""Shared, boundary-aware matching for emails, names, phones, and opaque IDs."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unicodedata
from functools import lru_cache


@lru_cache(maxsize=65536)
def _fold_latin(text: str) -> str:
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text.casefold())
    return "".join(char for char in normalized if not unicodedata.combining(char))


@lru_cache(maxsize=65536)
def _digits_only(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\D", "", text)


@lru_cache(maxsize=65536)
def _phone_digit_sequences(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Extract phone-like digit groups without crossing text or identifier boundaries."""
    chunks = tuple(re.finditer(r"\d+", text))
    found: set[str] = set()
    for start, first in enumerate(chunks):
        combined = first.group(0)
        if 7 <= len(combined) <= 15:
            found.add(combined)
        for end in range(start + 1, min(len(chunks), start + 19)):
            gap = text[chunks[end - 1].end():chunks[end].start()]
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[+\s().-]*", gap):
                break
            combined += chunks[end].group(0)
            if 7 <= len(combined) <= 15:
                found.add(combined)
            if len(combined) > 15:
                break
    return tuple(found)


@lru_cache(maxsize=4096)
def _whole_token_pattern(identifier: str) -> re.Pattern[str]:
    return re.compile(rf"(?<![\w]){re.escape(identifier)}(?![\w])", re.IGNORECASE)


@lru_cache(maxsize=4096)
def _email_pattern(identifier: str) -> re.Pattern[str]:
    # Prevent an address from matching as a prefix or suffix of a different
    # address while allowing ordinary punctuation around it in logs and text.
    # Keep common local-part characters in the boundary class. Excluding the
    # key/value separator `=` is important because structured logs commonly
    # contain `lookup_key=<address>`.
    local_part_chars = r"A-Za-z0-9._%+'-"
    domain_chars = r"A-Za-z0-9.-"
    return re.compile(
        rf"(?<![{local_part_chars}]){re.escape(identifier)}(?![{domain_chars}])",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )


@lru_cache(maxsize=4096)
def _hash_pattern(identifier: str) -> re.Pattern[str]:
    return re.compile(
        rf"(?<![0-9a-f]){re.escape(identifier)}(?![0-9a-f])",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )


def contains_identifier(text: str, identifier: str) -> bool:
    """Match a complete email, phone, name, or opaque identifier token."""
    candidate = identifier.strip()
    if not candidate:
        return False
    if "@" in candidate:
        return _email_pattern(candidate).search(text) is not None
    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", candidate, re.IGNORECASE):
        return _hash_pattern(candidate).search(text) is not None

    digits = _digits_only(candidate)
    if len(digits) >= 7 and len(digits) > len(candidate) // 2:
        return any(
            sequence == digits
            or 1 <= len(sequence) - len(digits) <= 3 and sequence.endswith(digits)
            for sequence in _phone_digit_sequences(text)
        )

    if any(char.isspace() for char in candidate) or not candidate.isascii():
        folded_text = _fold_latin(text)
        folded_candidate = _fold_latin(candidate)
        if not any(char.isspace() for char in candidate):
            return _whole_token_pattern(folded_candidate).search(folded_text) is not None
        name_pattern = r"(?<![\w])" + r"\s+".join(
            re.escape(token) for token in folded_candidate.split()
        ) + r"(?![\w])"
        return re.search(name_pattern, folded_text) is not None

    return _whole_token_pattern(candidate).search(text) is not None

    ]

        records = [record for record in timeline.evidence_records if (record.system_id, record.resource_id, record.data_category) == (system_id, resource_id, category)]
        latest = max(records, key=_record_observation_key)
        can_block = parse_bool(latest.fields.get("can_block_restore", latest.fields.get("restore_access_blockable")))
        allowed = parse_bool(latest.fields.get("restore_allowed", latest.fields.get("restore_enabled")))
        result = str(latest.fields.get("result", latest.fields.get("status", ""))).upper()
        if can_block is not False and (
            allowed is True
            or result in {"ACTIVE", "RESTORE_ALLOWED", "RESTORABLE"}
            or _normalized_state(latest) == "ACTIVE"
        ):
            assessments.append(PolicyAssessment(
                system_id=system_id,
                resource_id=resource_id,
                data_category=category,
                action="BLOCK_RESTORE",
                state="ACTIVE",
                evidence_id=latest.evidence_id,
                observed_at=latest.observed_at,
                violation_operation="REPORT_RESTORE_RISK",
                remediation_operation="BLOCK_RESTORE",
                remediation_state="BLOCKED",
                verification_operation="VERIFY_RESTORE_BLOCKED",
                verification_state="BLOCKED",
                compliant=False,
            ))
        elif allowed is False or result in {"BLOCKED", "RESTORE_BLOCKED"} or _normalized_state(latest) == "BLOCKED":
            assessments.append(PolicyAssessment(
                system_id=system_id,
                resource_id=resource_id,
                data_category=category,
                action="BLOCK_RESTORE",
                state="BLOCKED",
                evidence_id=latest.evidence_id,
                observed_at=latest.observed_at,
                verification_operation="VERIFY_RESTORE_BLOCKED",
                verification_state="BLOCKED",
                compliant=True,
            ))

    # Keep only the latest assessment per system/resource/category/action.
    by_key: dict[tuple[str, str, str, str], PolicyAssessment] = {}
    for assessment in assessments:
        key = (assessment.system_id, assessment.resource_id, assessment.data_category, assessment.action)
        prior = by_key.get(key)
        if prior is None or _time(assessment.observed_at) >= _time(prior.observed_at):
            by_key[key] = assessment
    return tuple(sorted(by_key.values(), key=lambda item: (item.system_id, item.resource_id, item.action)))
